items.title: US500 rises to 7,524 points on Aug 2, +0.46%
items.content: US500 rose to 7,524 points on August 2, 2026, gaining 0.46% from the previous session; +18.87% YoY, -0.18% over the past month.

items.title: Stocks build on rally led by tech; Microsoft best day since 2008
items.content: Microsoft (MSFT) gained 15.5% on strong earnings and a commitment to remain FCF positive — best day since 2008. Rally led by tech and Amazon; Nvidia scheduled to report Aug 26.

items.title: Outlook for Aug 3-7: S&P 500 profits tracking +47%
items.content: Aggregate S&P 500 corporate profits tracking to grow more than 47%; RBC's Lori Calvasina reiterates 8,150 price target, sees opportunities from choppiness. Risks: midterm elections, rate outlook, weak Aug/Sep seasonality.

items.title: Stock market turmoil sheds light on opaque AI economy
items.content: Reports that China developed its own deep-ultraviolet (DUV) lithography tools, breaking ASML's monopoly; AI-linked chip shares dropped worldwide. South Korea's Kospi fell 11.5% on Tuesday and a further 6% on Wednesday, dragged by SK Hynix and Samsung.

items.title: Tech stocks tumble on AI spending worries and China's chips
items.content: Month-long sell-off driven by fears over ballooning big-tech AI infrastructure spending and cheaper competitors; China competition has loosened South Korea's grip on AI memory chips.

items.title: China chipmaker CXMT shares surge 466% in debut — biggest IPO since 2010
items.content: CXMT raised at least $8.6 billion at 8.66 yuan/share on Shanghai's STAR Market; became the most valuable company on the Shanghai Stock Exchange.

items.title: 2026 Iran war: June MoU seeks to reopen Strait of Hormuz
items.content: Despite the June 2026 memorandum of understanding that seeks to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and end the Iran war, Iran continues to assert hegemonic control over the strait and seek fees on transiting ships.

items.title: 2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis — tensions ongoing, strait closed since Mar 4
items.content: Tensions between Iran, the US and Israel escalated in the lead-up to 2026, stemming from failed Geneva nuclear negotiations and a prior 12-day air conflict. Iranian forces declared the strait 'closed' starting March 4, 2026, attacking ships attempting transit.

items.title: Iran still claims control of Strait of Hormuz, threatens naval mines
items.content: Iran continues its illegal claim over the Strait of Hormuz and uses the threat of naval mines to deter commercial vessels from using non-Iranian-approved routes, showing it still seeks control.

items.title: June 2026 PCE inflation falls 0.1% MoM, consumer spending up 0.3%
items.content: US PCE price index fell 0.1% MoM in June, as expected, after +0.5% in May; goods prices fell 0.6% (most since Nov 2023), services inflation slowed to 0.1% from 0.5%.

items.title: US PCE annual rate cools to 3.7% in June from 4.1%
items.content: PCE Price Index annual change in the US decreased to 3.70% in June from 4.10% in May 2026.

items.title: Earnings calendar this week (Aug 3-7): Caterpillar Q2 in focus
items.content: Wall Street expects Caterpillar Q2 EPS of $6.20 (+31.4% YoY) on revenue $19.2bn (+15.7% YoY); heavy earnings week — 340+ reports Tue, 491 Wed, 584 Thu.

items.title: Hang Seng closes at 25,884.43, +0.10% on July 31
items.content: Hang Seng Index closed at 25,884.43, +25.55 points (+0.10%) at July 31 close, steady after post-Fed choppiness.

items.title: Hang Seng surges 1.76% despite Japan M7.5 earthquake
items.content: Hong Kong's benchmark surged 1.76% as traders snapped up beaten-down stocks, unfazed by Japan's magnitude 7.5 earthquake that rattled regional sentiment.
